name: plotforge
description: Offline visual story planning for macOS, Windows, and the browser

scripts.desktop:check: npm run build && cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:test: npm run build && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features custom-protocol
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features custom-protocol,native-smoke && node scripts/plot/smoke-desktop.mjs
